name: PT Mitra Angkasa Sejahtera Tbk
summary: PT Mitra Angkasa Sejahtera Tbk, headquartered in Tangerang, Indonesia, is a key distributor of various fastening solutions throughout Indonesia. The company's comprehensive product line features a wide array of screws, including tapping, socket, self-drilling, drywall, and stainless-steel types. Additionally, they supply bolts (such as hexagon bolts), washers, nuts, and blind rivets. These items are sold under numerous brand names, notably PATTA, PTA, FastFix, YFS, THE, TMS, SNAP, Unison, BDS, and RJ, among others. Customers can purchase their products through a network of 20 physical retail locations or via their online platform. Further extending its market presence, the firm also offers opportunities to franchise its distribution business. PT Mitra Angkasa Sejahtera Tbk was established in 2012.
